inputs.memory: content, category, metadata, namespace, provenance, and optional supersedes_id. Legacy callers that supply only content, category, and metadata use namespace default and empty provenance.
inputs.backup: A v2 object containing canonical records, user profile state, and a deterministic checksum for each record.
inputs.restore: A backup object and dry_run flag. Validation occurs before an active-store transaction begins.

record.authority: SQLite memories rows and retained memory revision snapshots are canonical. FTS is derived and rebuildable.

outputs.restore_report: Dry runs return validated without changing the database. Successful restores return restored only after the complete replacement transaction commits.

errors: Memory backup schema version must be 2.
A memory record checksum mismatch rejects the restore before active state changes.
A restore with duplicate ids, invalid namespace, malformed provenance, or invalid revision rejects atomically.
Search-index rebuild failure never replaces or corrupts canonical memory records.

compatibility.legacy_rows: Existing v1 rows migrate in place with namespace default, empty provenance, revision 1, null supersedes_id, updated_at equal to created_at, and an immediately calculated checksum.
compatibility.search: Legacy search, export, update, and delete call shapes remain supported. New governance fields are additive in returned records.
compatibility.atomicity: A failed restore leaves the canonical active rows and user profile unchanged; FTS remains disposable derived state.
compatibility.unknown_major: reject without mutating the active store
